changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla user_profiles: hoja de vida opcional del aprendiz (1 a 1 con users) con valores neutros de nivel de formación. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría user_profiles_audit y el trigger user_profiles_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Optional learner resume profile (one to one with users); feeds the profile prior of the diagnostic

column.name: description
column.remarks: Free-text description of the current knowledge of the user

column.name: tools
column.remarks: Tools the user knows, as a JSON array of strings

column.name: languages
column.remarks: Languages as a JSON array of {code, cefr_level}

column.name: resume_completed_at
column.remarks: Moment the resume was completed; null while incomplete

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD CONSTRAINT user_profiles_education_level_ck CHECK (education_level IS NULL OR education_level IN ('secondary', 'technical', 'undergraduate', 'postgraduate', 'other', 'none'))
ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD CONSTRAINT user_profiles_tools_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(tools) = 'array')
ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD CONSTRAINT user_profiles_languages_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(languages) = 'array')
CREATE TRIGGER user_profiles_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in user_profiles

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE user_profiles_audit ADD CONSTRAINT user_profiles_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER user_profiles_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON user_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS user_profiles_audit_trg ON user_profiles
